verbatim_quote.original: تو باید با s-mcp-inject-diff-clean صدا بزنی که خودش کامیت رو بکنه.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: You must call it via s-mcp-inject-diff-clean, which performs the commit itself.

extracted_decision.summary: On approval-for-closure the Hands must commit through the sanctioned MCP commit path (stage_and_inject_diff + commit_and_clean_task over MCP stdio), never raw git and never by leaving commits to the Manager.
extracted_decision.rationale: Manager expects closure to include the actual commit; ZAC bans only raw git, not the MCP commit tools.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Hands must know the MCP stdio fallback when the tool is not in its function list.
